deliverySummary: Delivery across India. Typical delivery takes 4–7 days.
shippingPolicy:
We deliver across India. Typical delivery takes 4–7 days. Delivery timing can vary by destination and courier conditions; contact us if your parcel is delayed.

Delivery charges are displayed in your bag and at checkout. Charges are calculated per pack, with free delivery where the displayed order threshold is met. Any additional cash-on-delivery fee is shown separately before you place your order.

Enter your complete address, PIN code and reachable mobile number. When your order is dispatched, courier and tracking details are added to your private order page. Keep your order link safe.

For delivery questions, contact mohammadnuzair@gmail.com or WhatsApp +91 8296795986, 9:00 am–6:00 pm IST.
returnsPolicy:
Our teas are food products. We do not accept change-of-mind cancellations, returns or exchanges after an order is confirmed.

If an item arrives damaged, incorrect, unsafe, defective or materially different from its description, or you have another delivery problem, contact mohammadnuzair@gmail.com or WhatsApp +91 8296795986 with your order number and a description of the issue. Photos of the item and packaging help us investigate. Do not consume any item you believe may be unsafe, and do not send products back without contacting us first.

We will assess the issue and arrange an appropriate remedy, which may include a replacement or refund. For an approved online refund, the refund is processed through the payment provider; the time to appear in your account depends on the provider and your bank. For an approved COD refund, we will agree the refund method with you directly.

This policy does not limit any remedies you are entitled to under applicable consumer law.
privacyPolicy:
Zaman Tea uses the details you provide to process purchases, arrange delivery, respond to support requests and maintain order records. These details include your name, phone number, optional email address, delivery address, order contents, payment status and delivery notes.

Your shopping bag and most recent private order link are stored in your browser. Checkout retry information may be stored for the current browser session. Store management uses a session cookie. Anyone with your private order link can view that order, so keep it private.

Online payments, when available, are handled by Razorpay. The store records payment references and status; it does not collect your full card details. Choosing WhatsApp opens a prepared message containing the details needed for your enquiry or order; you choose whether to send it.

We share the details needed to fulfil your order with delivery providers, payment services and, when enabled, our email delivery service. We use operational logs and backups to run and protect the store. Order information is kept as needed for fulfilment, support, accounting and applicable retention obligations.

To ask about your information or request a correction or deletion, email mohammadnuzair@gmail.com. Some records may need to be retained for legitimate business or legal obligations. Support is available 9:00 am–6:00 pm IST.
termsPolicy:
This store is operated as Zaman Tea, Behind TGIO, Rangankere, Barkur–Mandarthi Road. Contact: mohammadnuzair@gmail.com; WhatsApp +91 8296795986; support 9:00 am–6:00 pm IST.

Prices are shown in Indian rupees. Review the chosen tea, pack size, quantity, delivery charge, any COD fee and final total before ordering. Prices and availability may change before your order is placed; checkout verifies the total.

A cash-on-delivery order is confirmed when the website creates the order. An online order awaits payment until payment is verified. A WhatsApp message is an enquiry or order request; confirmation is arranged in the conversation. Online payment is offered only when available at checkout.

Provide accurate delivery and contact details. Use the private order link to check progress and contact us with your order number if you need help. Our shipping policy and cancellation/returns policy form part of these purchase terms.

The printable order receipt summarizes your purchase and is not a tax invoice. Contact us if you require a tax invoice. Nothing in these terms removes rights that cannot be excluded under applicable law.
